scale: S = max(w, h, D): w, h are the sizes of viewDefaults.bounds (or defaultBounds), D = hypot(xmax - xmin, ymax - ymin) over the free points of the case (0 without free points)

units.check.passed: times S: error <= passed * S is passed
units.check.failed: times S: error >= failed * S is failed, between is inconclusive

expr.text: limits of AST v1 (docs/native/expr.md): the root is at depth 1; maxIntegerPower bounds |n| of an integer literal exponent; a tree over a limit is the issue formula

generator.rule: refuse a case when a degeneracy decision value m satisfies 0 < |m| < decisionMargin * tol, tol being the decide tolerance of that decision
generator.noiseRule: for a noise decision |m| <= tol / decisionMargin also counts as exactly on the threshold: the value is the rounding noise of an exact construction (a point on both curves, a tangent built as tangent, a straight angle built from collinear points; registry 1.6: a degenerate conic built as degenerate, a parabola, a circle or an axis along x given by an equation or five points, a quadratic equation read at points; rc12: coincident Euler centers of an equilateral triangle; registry 1.8: a conic met with itself, two conics about one centre, a common point on the ray between the centres; registry 1.9: the rest of the jump bisection of a continuous graph, a limit of an area at a common point of its two boundaries, a vertex of region.by_boundary on its carrier and at the end of its part, a ring of exactly zero area, pieces that meet exactly at an end or at their common vertex)
